rationale: Recent scalar sweeps and anchor/carry variants have flattened, while the strongest nearby local miss was late validation-aligned loss curriculum. This edit keeps the recurrent-tail/export path intact and adds a compact late-phase training mask that gradually upweights the final eval-stride tokens of each sequence while preserving average loss scale. It reuses the existing masked-loss code path, activates only late in training, stays compile-stable, and directly targets the exact sliding-window score instead of generic early-token loss.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Loss Bias Curriculum
